title: Static2Fresh — Goin' Up
description: An official music video for "Goin' Up" by Static2Fresh — San Diego-area rapper Sammy Mathis, repping Oceanside to the bay. A last-minute idea born at a private event: Static2Fresh wasn't even booked to perform that night, but once the other artists' live sets wrapped, the hosts gave the green light to shoot right there on the spot. Directed by Jacob Willett.
